observations: Small bedside-style refrigerator with 'POLYSTAR' branding on the front door.
The door exterior has multiple stickers and significant adhesive residue from removed stickers.
The top surface of the fridge appears dusty with some debris.
Interior view shows a small freezer compartment at the top, two wire shelves, and a plastic crisper drawer at the bottom.
There is visible brown staining or rust along the bottom inner frame and door seal area in photo 1.
A thermostat control dial is visible in the upper right of the interior.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows significant cosmetic wear and sticker residue.
The photos do not show the unit powered on or any evidence of cooling.
Requires a functional test or a photo showing ice formation in the freezer.

risks.proof: A video showing the unit running and a thermometer inside showing a drop in temperature.

risks.risk: Compromised door seal due to rust
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bottom gasket and the metal frame it rests against.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's sticker (usually on the back) to confirm the model number and age.
Video of the fridge plugged in with the interior light on and frost visible in the freezer compartment.
Clear photo of the bottom hinge and door seal to check for structural rust.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Polystar bedside refrigerator. Although the specific model number is missing, the brand and type are sufficient for pricing. It is priced at its worst case (not working) due to the lack of functional proof and visible signs of neglect and potential rust.
